diagnosis.not_a_data_label_or_layout_bug: [measured] the fit and validation bags are bit-identical (sha256) to those of results/20260924T215754Z_ssl_r2_hao_gpu_exploratory; labels are balanced 0/1 and the package encodes them as +T/-T; the hierarchy ((AND_GROUP, 2000), (OR_ALTERNATIVES, A), (AND_ALTERNATIVES, 4)) spans exactly the 2,000 input features (the package aborts otherwise) and every leaf sees all features, the right layout for bags; training is deterministic (h35 and h37, the same configuration, have identical curves through epoch 50).
diagnosis.failure_mode_of_the_exploratory_setting: [measured] every GATED configuration (T between 8 and 3,000: 22 hierarchical, h01 to h12, h16, h19, h27 to h32, h34, h36, and 22 flat, f01 to f12, f16, f19, f27 to f32, f34, f36; s 2 to 21.1; 4 to 8,192 clauses; with and without negated literals; boost 0 and 1) ends with leaves that hold about one POSITIVE DISTRACTOR literal (0.82 to 1.17 distractor literals and at most 0.23 group-word literals per positive-clause leaf; group-word coverage 0.00 in every gated hierarchical run) and none exceeds training accuracy 0.62. In the exploratory setting itself (h01: 16 clauses, 8 alternatives, T 100, s 5) all 8,000 fit bags have class sum -T at epoch 1 and 99 percent at epoch 40, so every prediction is negative and accuracy is exactly 0.5000; the exploratory run's printed hierarchy likewise shows mostly single distractor literals (its group-word coverage was 0.0).
diagnosis.why: [derived from the package source (installed c85ca4e7: kernels.py evaluate_leaves, evaluate_or_alternatives, evaluate_and_groups, update_component_hierarchy) and the measured bag statistics] (i) H-AO carries no first-order signal by construction: every group word has P(word | positive) = P(word | negative) = 0.196 on the fit bags [measured], so Type I and Type II feedback, which move each literal according to its class-conditional frequency, have no gradient toward group words; only a clause that already holds most of the AND-OR structure receives class-discriminative feedback. (ii) With T small enough to gate, the update probability |y - clip(class_sum)|/(2T) is error-driven; without literal-level signal the deterministic Type II increments over all ~1,970 absent literals favour the rarest words (a distractor is absent from 98.8 percent of bags, a group word from 80 percent) and a leaf that holds one rare distractor fires on 1.2 percent of bags and then rarely receives feedback: the observed single-distractor leaves. (iii) The hierarchical vote scale adds a second route to the same state: a clause outputs the PRODUCT over its 4 concept nodes of the NUMBER of firing alternatives, and an empty leaf outputs 1 in training and inference alike, so a clause whose leaves are empty votes up to 8^4 = 4,096, about 40 times T = 100; a few such clauses pin class sums at +-T (h01: saturated share 1.00), which sets the update probability to 0 for one class and 1 for the other. The package's later HEAD 5b4a223 (not installed; docs/12 F26 fixes R2 to c85ca4e7) adds the switches binary_inference (a firing clause votes its weight, not weight times product), constant_update_p (update probability 1), and_group_normalization and no_clipping, aimed at this vote-scale problem.
diagnosis.what_changes_it: [measured] T = 1e5 or 1e6, far above any reachable class sum, keeps the update probability near 0.5 for every example (ungated feedback). Positive literals then take group words (h14, h18: 1.4 to 1.9 group-word literals per leaf, 0.00 distractors, coverage 0.67 to 0.96) but the concept nodes do not align with the groups (OR-group recovery 0.18 to 0.21) and training accuracy stays 0.55 to 0.61; the negative class ('some group missing') has no positive-literal description, and the single-output rule 'class sum >= 0 means positive' needs negative votes on every negative bag [derived]. Negated literals at s 10 fill each leaf with about 140 negated distractors and memorise (h20, h21: train 0.77 to 0.79, val 0.49); a negated rare word is true whenever its leaf fires, so its Type I drift equals that of the leaf's defining literal (p_fire - 1/s) and negations accumulate until the leaf fires on about 1/s of its feedback events [derived]. Only negated literals at s 4 learn AND generalise: hierarchical h35/h37 (64 clauses) reach train 0.868 to 0.894 and val 0.683 to 0.708 with a plateau from epoch 60 to 150; their negative clauses carry 1.4 to 1.6 negated group words per leaf, the positive clauses end with group-word coverage 0.00 and OR-group recovery 0.00, so the trained hierarchical model does NOT represent the AND of OR-groups; the flat counterpart (2,048 clauses, same T, s, literals) carries 3.3 negated group words per negative-clause leaf and generalises better (f35/f37 val 0.799 to 0.814).
diagnosis.tuning_outcome: [measured] no configuration made the hierarchical model reach training accuracy 0.95; the bar was not lowered. The chosen configurations are the validation-best ones, reported with their training accuracy.
